name: Horní Stropnice (Czechia)
description: White field with a broad red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, with a white square in the centre bearing a red rose with yellow centre and green sepals, and red triangles in the upper hoist and lower fly corners.
history: Czech municipal flags are granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
